svg.aria-label: NormBrainAGE for one part. Training: the voxel matrix X, n subjects by p voxels, is standardized and reduced by PCA to the score matrix S, n by K. Each column of S gets a normal GAMLSS of age. The z-scores Z of the training subjects give the residual correlation R, K by K. The axes, the models and R are saved. Test: the subject's voxels are projected onto the saved axes to K scores, z-scores are computed for every age of a grid, combined with R into the log-likelihood of age, and its maximum is the brain age with a standard error.
